item.name: Rainbow Rooms
item.summary: A colorful early-run floor family built around the recurring Rainbow Room layouts.
item.landmarks: Colorful room clusters and recurring routes around the floor's elevator and Machines.
item.cardSummary: The seven-variant early floor family most often used to learn the run's basic routes.

item.name: Artist
item.summary: An animation-studio floor with drawing-room and production-themed spaces.
item.landmarks: Studio rooms, episode posters, desks, storyboards, and animation reference material.
item.cardSummary: A three-variant early floor whose studio landmarks make its route shape easy to recognize.

item.name: Art Floor
item.summary: A museum-style floor with yellow gallery halls, paintings, displays, and a central Dandy statue.
item.landmarks: Yellow museum halls, art displays, paintings, and the central Dandy statue.
item.cardSummary: The single-variant museum floor; sources also call it Art Gallery, which is kept as an alias.

item.name: Aquatic Floor
item.summary: An aquatic-themed standard floor with a distinct map layout and its own route choices.
item.landmarks: Aquatic-themed rooms and the floor's elevator and Machine routes.
item.cardSummary: A one-variant early floor with an aquatic theme and a separate layout to learn.

item.name: Greenhouse
item.summary: A greenhouse-like floor where plant-filled scenery shapes the available paths and sightlines.
item.landmarks: Plant-filled rooms and nature-inspired spaces, including greenhouse-style cover.
item.cardSummary: A two-variant early floor where plant scenery changes the shape of routes and sightlines.

item.name: Library Floor
item.summary: A library-themed floor with shelf-lined spaces and room-to-room routes.
item.landmarks: Bookshelves, reading spaces, and the library's connected room routes.
item.cardSummary: The single-variant library floor, kept separate from older source terminology about projector layouts.

item.name: Diner
item.summary: A diner floor divided between dining areas and a kitchen, with three variants.
item.landmarks: Dining spaces, kitchen routes, and the floor's distinct restaurant sections.
item.cardSummary: A three-variant restaurant floor with separate dining and kitchen spaces to navigate.

item.name: Warehouse
item.summary: A large warehouse floor with concrete-and-metal spaces, storage areas, and exposed routes.
item.landmarks: Fenced areas, storage rooms, industrial walls, and broad machine approaches.
item.cardSummary: A three-variant later floor with large industrial spaces and longer exposed approaches.

item.name: Gift Shop
item.summary: A late-run retail floor whose aisles and display shelving shape movement.
item.landmarks: Retail aisles, display shelving, and shop-floor sightlines.
item.cardSummary: The single-variant late standard floor built around shop aisles and display cover.

item.name: Astro's Floor
item.summary: A space-themed floor with planetarium or museum-style exhibits and broad open sections.
item.landmarks: Planetarium-style exhibits, space displays, and open floor sections.
item.cardSummary: Astro's one-variant main-character floor, identified by its space and planetarium-style exhibits.

item.name: Shelly's Floor
item.summary: A dinosaur-museum floor with fossil displays, dig-site areas, and narrow corridors.
item.landmarks: Fossil exhibits, dinosaur displays, dig-site sandboxes, and tight passageways.
item.cardSummary: Shelly's one-variant museum floor, built around dinosaur exhibits and a dig-site landmark.

item.name: Sprout's Floor
item.summary: A kitchen-and-dining floor that opens into a bright outdoor-like area.
item.landmarks: Kitchen and dining spaces connected to a bright outdoor-like section.
item.cardSummary: Sprout's one-variant floor, combining kitchen and dining routes with an outdoor-like area.

item.name: Vee's Floor
item.summary: A game-show and vintage-technology floor with arcade displays and separated cover.
item.landmarks: Game-show spaces, arcade displays, vintage technology, and separated cover islands.
item.cardSummary: Vee's one-variant floor, recognizable by its game-show setting and arcade-style displays.

item.name: Dyle's Floor
item.summary: An optional challenge floor built around a fixed machine clear and a dangerous Twisted encounter.
item.spawnTrigger: Choose the TIME'S UP Card on an odd-numbered floor.
item.landmarks: A challenge layout centered on its fixed Machine objective and Dyle encounter.
item.twistedNotes: Four Twisteds spawn, including Twisted Dyle.
item.specialReward: +50 maximum Stamina for the rest of the run.
item.cardSummary: The one-variant TIME'S UP challenge: clear 25 Machines, survive four Twisteds, and gain maximum Stamina afterward.

item.name: Break Room
item.summary: A safe sub-floor used as a rest stop between long-run milestones.
item.spawnTrigger: Appears after every 25th floor is cleared.
item.landmarks: A compact rest-room layout with preset Machine locations.
item.machineNotes: Two Machines appear in preset locations.
item.cardSummary: The one-variant safe milestone floor: complete its two preset Machines before continuing the run.
